text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages locked in gains, but I should avoid trimming winners automatically without reassessing their prospects and my target allocation.","Selling Stocks C and E after losses did not prevent further account declines; I should set clear, deliberate risk limits rather than react to recent price moves or my average cost.","In retirement, protecting the account matters more than frequent trading; I should keep a diversified, measured approach and accept that short-term gains or losses do not prove a strategy is sound."]}
